C1636.title: Hardcoded Encryption Key Vulnerability in VR-S1000 Firmware
C1636.summary: VR-S1000 firmware versions 2.37 and earlier contain hardcoded encryption keys, which could allow an attacker to analyze user passwords for specific products. The vulnerability has been documented in a GitHub security advisory.
